name: Galaxea G0.5 base
license_note: G0.5 Community License, non-commercial. Gated on the Hub.
notes: LeRobot conversion of G0.5 base. The VLM is Qwen3.5-2B-Base (hidden 2048); the action expert is a separate width-1024 stack and is dropped by the shape check. G0.5's own prompt has no free-form question slot, so this eval uses the base VLM processor on the copied backbone weights.
convention: lm-evaluation-harness arc_easy, 0-shot: raw 'Question: {question}\nAnswer:' and each choice text as a continuation; argmax of summed log-probability (acc) and of log-probability per character (acc_norm)
